Name: Extra File
Description: An additional relative path (e.g. sound/custom/mysound.wav) to always include, for dependencies the automatic scan can't find (referenced only through custom entity keys, dynamically loaded, etc.).

Name: Skip Base Game Fallback
Description: Don't search the base game's shared content folder (the sibling of your mod folder, e.g. 'valve' next to 'your_mod') for dependencies not found in your mod folder.

Name: Verbose Scan Log
Description: Log every entity key/value pair and file the scan considers, not just what it included or couldn't find.
